controls.method: Original get_file_hash/can_hardlink AST methods; real temporary files, independent hashlib oracle; logging adapter; no main-module import, dependency install, GUI or Plex connection.

findings: Default hash matches independent SHA256; compatible equal-content separate files admitted, same-size unequal files and physical hardlink aliases refused; unavailable file returns None.
Public chunk_size=0 yields SHA256(empty) for nonempty file; tested API input is invalid but not rejected. Normal application calls use default and are not shown affected.
can_hardlink compares device/inode/size and hash, without final source freshness or byte confirmation. Actual replacement path read but not exercised.
create_hardlink uses fixed target.plexdedupe_backup name and move/link/remove/restore sequence; no production filesystem conversion run.
Source invokes dependency checker at import and may offer pip installation; research AST extraction avoids those side effects. Requirements.txt is prose, no exact versions.
Source claims Python3.6+, but get_file_hash uses assignment expression requiring Python3.8+; no Python3.6 run.
license: Root MIT fully read; research controls retain copyright/license; no production adoption.
limits: No actual Plex, full GUI, media matching corpus, deletion/conversion or performance qualification. Native pHash/ASAN deferred.
